title: Regional Language Strategy: How Gujarat Titans Can Speak to Multiple Audiences
dek: Gujarat Titans are followed far beyond one city. Where they have played maps the regions, and the languages, a franchise has to speak to.
excerpt: Gujarat Titans have played in many cities, and only a share of their matches at Ahmedabad. The travelling fixture list is a map of the audiences a multilingual strategy would serve.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: GT have played in {{ev:rl-cities-n}} cities, all of them in India.
{{ev:rl-home}} of their matches were at Ahmedabad.
Every one of their matches has been played in India.

sections.heading: A Franchise Followed Everywhere
body: IPL franchises carry a city's name but draw fans from across the country and beyond. A regional language strategy starts from where those fans are.
Gujarat Titans have played in {{ev:rl-cities-n}} cities and only {{ev:rl-home}} of their matches at Ahmedabad.

sections.heading: Every Venue Is a Local Audience
body: Each away fixture is a chance to speak to fans in that city's language. The chart lists the cities where GT have played most often.
The fixture list is a map of venues, not of fans; it shows where the team goes, not where its supporters live.

sections.heading: Speaking to Multiple Audiences
body: A multilingual strategy usually means regional-language social channels, commentary partnerships and player content in the languages of the squad and the fan base.

sections.heading: What the Warehouse Cannot See
body: The CricField warehouse is ball-by-ball cricket data. It contains no audience location, language preference or regional engagement data, so it cannot measure the commercial side of this question directly.
Building the strategy properly would need audience location and language data from the franchise's own channels and broadcasters.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Follow the Fixture Map
body: Gujarat Titans travel to many cities every season. Away fixtures offer natural moments for regional-language content.
Which languages to prioritise needs audience data that this warehouse does not hold.
